subject: Vendor onboarding: hold on PO issuance / spend cap and duplicate line-items
messages:

Cc: accounts@solacecloud.com
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: PO request + onboarding form for SolaceCloud (initial)

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks for the walkthrough yesterday. Attached are the completed onboarding form and a draft invoice with line items we usually submit for customers of this size. We need a purchase order number to kick off provisioning and to bind the initial invoice.

A couple of items to flag up front:
- Our standard billing net is 30 days; please confirm if Redwood uses a different net.
- The spend cap in your intake form (USD 25,000) is lower than the expected monthly run-rate for the first quarter. Can procurement provision a provisional cap or a temporary override while the account completes credit terms?
- There is an extra line in row 7 of the invoice ("Integration services - misc") that should be rolled into line 3. We attached an annotated invoice.

Attached: solace_onboarding-form.pdf; solace_invoice-draft.xlsx

Thanks,
Evan Li

Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2026 10:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: PO request + onboarding form for SolaceCloud (initial)

Hi Evan — thanks, got the form and the draft invoice. Quick confirmation items before I pass to procurement:

1) Tax / billing entity — the onboarding form is missing SolaceCloud's VAT/Tax ID in section 2. Can you resend that? I attached a one-line note to the form for where it should go.
2) Billing contact — please confirm whether accounts@solacecloud.com is the billing recipient (looks correct but want to be explicit).
3) Spend cap request — Monica / Rishi: the vendor is asking for a provisional spend cap increase to $75,000/month while we finalize credit terms. Is that feasible to provision temporarily? If not, what's the fastest partial workaround (e.g., staged PO issuance + temporary top-up)?
4) Line item cleanup — Evan: noted the duplicate/misc line. If you can send a cleaned invoice and a version that maps each SKU to a single line, procurement can issue the PO cleanly.

I am copying Monica (onboarding lead) and Rishi (procurement ops) to triage the PO issuance and spend cap escalation.

Next steps I propose: Evan sends the corrected invoice and Tax ID; Monica/Rishi confirm provisional cap and whether a provisional PO can be issued; I will then confirm PO number back to SolaceCloud and internal finance.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Sr. Vendor Programs Manager | Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com

Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2026 11:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: SolaceCloud onboarding — invoice/po details + ask for provisional cap

FYI forwarding Evan's files and my notes after a quick pass.

Quick summary from procurement ops review:
- The invoice has a duplicate "integration" line (row 7) and an unallocated "one-time setup" amount that should be split across two SKUs.
- The vendor did not provide company Tax ID — we need that for PO header and for AP to match.
- Current onboarding intake default spend cap is $25k/month. Ops can create a provisional PO up to $50k without leadership approval, but anything beyond $50k requires SSO approval and ticket escalation (JIRA-PO-1427).

Requests:
- Ben, can you create a provisional PO up to $50k so the vendor can begin onboarding while they provide tax docs? If Ben can also include a note in the PO that residual line item rebalancing is allowed within 10% total value, that will let AP accept the first invoice without blocking.
- If Kimberly/Rishi want to target $75k provisional, we will need to route to SSO (estimate 24–36 hours once JIRA ticket is live).

I've attached an annotated invoice (solace_invoice-draft.xlsx) and the onboarding form. Evan, please re-send the Tax ID and the cleaned invoice when you have a minute — we'll issue a provisional PO in the meantime to avoid blocking provisioning.

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Vendor Onboarding Lead | Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwood.com

Attachments: solace_invoice-draft.xlsx (annotated)

Subject: RE: SolaceCloud onboarding — provisional PO issued (PO-2026-5561)

All — created a provisional PO to unblock vendor provisioning. Details below and action items:

PO: PO-2026-5561 (provisional)
Amount: USD 50,000 (provisional)
Valid for: 30 days from issuance
Notes on PO: "Provisional PO issued pending receipt of Tax ID & corrected invoice. Procurement approves up to USD 50,000. Vendor may rebalance line items up to 10% of total value without re-issuance; any structural changes require reissuance."

Line item adjustments done by procurement team:
- Merged "Integration services - misc" (row 7) into "Integration services" (row 3). Quantities adjusted and unit pricing normalized — see attached PO stub.
- Removed duplicate SKU 9 and moved those charges into SKU 3.

Action items:
- Evan (SolaceCloud): please confirm you received PO-2026-5561 and acknowledge the 30-day provisional cap. Send Tax ID and the cleaned invoice (final) — AP will match to PO.
- Rishi: please mark this PO in the ledger as provisional and set a follow-up for SSO escalation if Kimberly requests >$50k. Link JIRA-PO-1427 for tracking.
- Kimberly/Monica: if you want immediate escalation to $75k instead of waiting for vendor docs, confirm here and I'll kick the SSO request.
